title: Decision Table — Address-Report Lateness Charge (Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing)
content:
For an address amendment on a Cardinal Financial Responsibility Filing certificate, the address-report lateness charge follows the reporting delay of the latest garaging change recorded on the named insured's Cardinal Personal Auto Policy records within the past month. The delay is counted in calendar days from that garaging change's effective date to the date it was recorded.

| Reporting delay of the latest garaging change recorded within the past month | Address-report lateness charge |
|---|---|
| More than 30 days | 12.00 |
| More than 14 days, no more than 30 days | 6.00 |
| 14 days or fewer | None |
| No garaging change recorded within the past month | None |

"Within the past month" covers garaging changes whose recorded date is less than one whole month before today, whole months being counted from the recorded date to today. Where several garaging changes were recorded in that month, the latest recorded is the one measured.

## Edge rows (hypothetical dates)

| Garaging change effective | Recorded | Delay | Charge |
|---|---|---|---|
| 2 September | 16 September | 14 | None |
| 2 September | 17 September | 15 | 6.00 |
| 2 September | 2 October | 30 | 6.00 |
| 2 September | 3 October | 31 | 12.00 |
